items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: he had George for quite a while... Yank Johnson, Yank Johnson and Buddy Johnson, Yank's brother, they used to play... with him

ctx.x: Roy Evans, yeah. Yeah, Roy. Roy was a wonderful drummer. Wonderful. Do you remember who would be members of Chris's band then?

Well it's about the same thing like the bands go now, they would change about it. But he had George for quite a while, and Georgia Boy, Zeb, Guy used to play the banjo mostly with him, Peter Papin, he played with him, Yank Johnson, Yank Johnson and Buddy Johnson, Yank's brother, they used to play, Earl Unford, he was his trombone player most of the time. And Chester Lazardi, bass man.
Did he use a piano ever?
